name: hollow-eu-sq
comment: A DELIBERATELY SMALL slice of hollow-eu, for measuring what k=2 costs without waiting on the full 14-tile solve. Four tiles: {3} {4} and the retrograde {3/2} {6/5}. It is not arbitrary — this subset already carries four of the 25 known uniform answers (GMS 1.2 = 4.4.3/2.3/2.3/2, GMS 1.4 = 4.3/2.4.3/2.3/2, GMS 1.17 = 4.3/2.4.6/5, and the convex 3.3.3.3.3.3, 4.4.4.4, 3.3.3.4.4, 3.6.3.6 ...), so a k=2 run over it is a real measurement of the same space and not a toy. No {8}, {12} or their star forms: those carry the 2-unit and 3-unit corners that make the words long and the search wide.
